title: Pronunciation Drills & Tricky Sounds
description: Latihan speaking intensif: silent letters, minimal pairs, dan tongue twisters ringan.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat ini — perhatikan silent 'k' di awal kata:
questions.sentence: I know the knight knocked on the door with his knuckles.
questions.translation: Aku tahu ksatria itu mengetuk pintu dengan buku-buku jarinya.
questions.answer: I know the knight knocked on the door with his knuckles.
questions.explanation: Huruf 'k' di depan 'n' selalu silent: know (/noʊ/), knight (/naɪt/), knocked (/nɒkt/), knuckles (/ˈnʌkəlz/). Jangan dibunyikan 'kuh-now'.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat ini — huruf 'b' di akhir 'climb' dan 'comb' tidak dibunyikan:
questions.sentence: She used a comb after the long climb up the hill.
questions.translation: Dia pakai sisir setelah mendaki bukit yang panjang.
questions.answer: She used a comb after the long climb up the hill.
questions.explanation: Silent 'b' setelah 'm': comb (/koʊm/), climb (/klaɪm/), lamb (/læm/), thumb (/θʌm/). Huruf 'b' tidak diucapkan.

questions.prompt: Kata mana yang TIDAK mengandung silent letter?
questions.sentence: Identify the word without a silent letter.
questions.translation: Temukan kata yang tidak ada huruf diamnya.

questions.prompt: Tongue twister ringan — ucapkan perlahan, lalu cepat:
questions.sentence: She sells seashells by the seashore.
questions.translation: Dia menjual kerang laut di tepi pantai.
questions.answer: She sells seashells by the seashore.
questions.explanation: Latihan bunyi /ʃ/ (sh) vs /s/. 'She' dan 'seashells' pakai /ʃ/, 'sells' dan 'seashore' campur keduanya. Pelan dulu, lalu tambah kecepatan.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang bunyinya sama dengan 'flower':
questions.sentence: The baker used ___ to make the bread.
questions.translation: Tukang roti pakai tepung untuk membuat roti.
questions.explanation: 'Flour' dan 'flower' adalah homophone — bunyinya sama persis (/flaʊər/) tapi artinya beda. 'Floor' bunyinya /flɔːr/.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat ini — bedakan 'desert' (gurun) dan 'dessert' (pencuci mulut):
questions.sentence: We had dessert after crossing the desert.
questions.translation: Kita makan pencuci mulut setelah menyeberangi gurun.
questions.answer: We had dessert after crossing the desert.
questions.explanation: 'Desert' (gurun) = /ˈdezərt/ tekanan di suku pertama. 'Dessert' (makanan penutup) = /dɪˈzɜːrt/ tekanan di suku kedua. Satu huruf 's' bikin beda total.

questions.sentence: Which pair of words rhyme with each other?
questions.translation: Pasangan kata mana yang berima satu sama lain?
questions.explanation: 'Through' (/θruː/) dan 'blue' (/bluː/) berima. 'Cough' (/kɒf/) dan 'rough' (/rʌf/) tidak. English spelling sangat tidak konsisten.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat ini — 'w' di awal 'write', 'wrong', 'wrap' itu silent:
questions.sentence: I wrote the wrong answer and had to wrap it up quickly.
questions.translation: Aku menulis jawaban yang salah dan harus menyelesaikannya dengan cepat.
questions.answer: I wrote the wrong answer and had to wrap it up quickly.
questions.explanation: Silent 'w' sebelum 'r': write (/raɪt/), wrong (/rɒŋ/), wrap (/ræp/). Jangan bunyikan 'wuh-rite'.

questions.prompt: Tongue twister — bedakan /θ/ (th keras) dan /ð/ (th lembut):
questions.sentence: The thirty-three thieves thought that they thrilled the throne.
questions.translation: Tiga puluh tiga pencuri mengira mereka menggetarkan singgasana.
questions.answer: The thirty-three thieves thought that they thrilled the throne.
questions.explanation: /θ/ (voiceless): thirty, thieves, thought, throne. /ð/ (voiced): the, that, they. Lidah di antara gigi — bukan /t/ atau /d/.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang bunyinya BERBEDA dari tiga lainnya:
questions.sentence: Which word sounds different? bough / cough / rough / tough
questions.explanation: 'Bough' = /baʊ/ (rima dengan 'cow'). 'Cough' = /kɒf/, 'rough' = /rʌf/, 'tough' = /tʌf/. Semua berakhiran '-ough' tapi bunyinya beda-beda — ini salah satu bagian tersulit English spelling.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat ini — perhatikan 'h' yang silent:
questions.sentence: It took him an hour to find the honest answer.
questions.translation: Butuh satu jam baginya menemukan jawaban yang jujur.
questions.answer: It took him an hour to find the honest answer.
questions.explanation: Silent 'h': hour (/aʊər/), honest (/ˈɒnɪst/). Makanya pakai 'an hour', bukan 'a hour' — mengikuti bunyi vokal, bukan huruf.

questions.sentence: The colonel led the troops into battle.
questions.translation: Sang kolonel memimpin pasukan ke pertempuran.
questions.explanation: 'Colonel' diucapkan persis seperti 'kernel' (/ˈkɜːrnəl/). Spelling-nya dari Itali, tapi pengucapannya dari Prancis. Salah satu kata paling aneh di English.

questions.sentence: Red lorry, yellow lorry, red lorry, yellow lorry.
questions.answer: Red lorry, yellow lorry, red lorry, yellow lorry.
questions.explanation: Bunyi /r/ (ujung lidah tidak menyentuh langit-langit) dan /l/ (ujung lidah menyentuh). Banyak penutur Asia kesulitan membedakan keduanya.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat ini — perhatikan tekanan kata (word stress):
questions.sentence: I need to record a record of all my records.
questions.translation: Aku perlu merekam catatan dari semua rekamanku.
questions.answer: I need to record a record of all my records.
questions.explanation: 'Record' sebagai VERB: tekanan di suku kedua (rɪˈkɔːrd). Sebagai NOUN: tekanan di suku pertama (ˈrekərd). Banyak kata English berubah arti tergantung stress.

questions.prompt: Pilih pasangan yang merupakan homophone (bunyi sama, arti beda):
questions.sentence: Which pair sounds exactly the same?
questions.translation: Pasangan mana yang bunyinya persis sama?
questions.explanation: 'Their' dan 'there' bunyinya sama: /ðɛr/. Juga 'they're'. Tiga kata ini adalah trio homophone paling sering bikin bingung.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat panjang ini dengan linking sounds yang natural:
questions.sentence: Would you mind if I asked you a couple of questions about your experience?
questions.translation: Apakah kamu keberatan kalau aku menanyakan beberapa pertanyaan tentang pengalamanmu?
questions.answer: Would you mind if I asked you a couple of questions about your experience?
questions.explanation: Natural linking: 'Would you' → /wʊdʒuː/, 'couple of' → /ˈkʌpələv/, 'about your' → /əˈbaʊtʃɔːr/. Kata-kata English menyambung satu sama lain saat bicara cepat.
